methodProvenance.confidenceFieldIsNotLoadBearing: Admission was decided structurally and from a source index of what the DS actually stamps, not from the scout grade. The double-census adjudication measured scout self-confidence at Cohen kappa 0.179 (REC-4).
methodProvenance.partAnchoringRule: R-8, decided from source: a part is admitted only where the DS stamps data-part with that name, or a DS component-identity class pair matches. Scout prose is corroboration, not authority.

sourceEvidence.engineDivergence: classic = Ant Pagination wrapper (src/ui/primitives/navigation/Pagination/engines/classic/index.tsx:51); no data-part, no --ds-* reads. modern owns twelve parts. rustic owns only six (root, pagination-range, pagination-nav-button, pagination-page-button, ellipsis, plus data-direction); it emits NO pagination-controls, pagination-simple-text, pagination-jumper, quick-jumper, pagination-size-changer, pagination-size-select or pagination-size-icon, so half the anatomy is modern-only.

inertFallbackChains.definition: A read whose OUTER rung already carries a :root default in a shipped stylesheet. The inner fallback rungs can never be consulted, so the control edge exists syntactically but is not causal. The modern skin states this rule in its own words at src/foundation/tokens/css/runtime/engines/modern/skin/overlay-modal.css:164-178.
